concept: Employees, customers, vendors/suppliers, and manufacturers \u{2014} all stored the same way, as entities with contact details. concept: Real profit or cost centers \u{2014} a division can be as simple as "Retail" and "Wholesale", or genuinely nested (e.g. "Retail" \u{2192} "Retail North"), the exact same kind of real hierarchy a product category can have. A division's own real transactions can be reported on separately (Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, P&L all accept a division filter), and Year End Close correctly rolls each division's own net income into its own real Retained Earnings line \u{2014} never blended together. A cost center's transactions are never allowed on an Income account; a profit center can post to either side.
text: Veri centri di profitto o di costo \u{2014} una divisione pu\u{f2} essere semplice come "Retail" e "Wholesale", oppure realmente annidata (ad es. Le registrazioni di un centro di costo non sono mai consentite su un conto di ricavi; un centro di profitto pu\u{f2} registrare su entrambi i lati.

concept: A sale to a customer on credit \u{2014} debits their Accounts Receivable balance, credits Sales Revenue.
text: Et kreditsalg til en kunde \u{2014} debiterer dennes debitorsaldo, krediterer salgsindt\u{e6}gterne.

concept: Commits to buying from a vendor \u{2014} memo only, no real ledger effect until a Stock Receipt fulfills it (all or item).
text: Forpligter til k\u{f8}b hos en leverand\u{f8}r \u{2014} kun en note, uden reel effekt p\u{e5} hovedbogen, f\u{f8}r en lagermodtagelse opfylder den (helt eller delvist).

concept: Create, rename, reparent, or change the relation of any entity directly. Parent is the real hierarchy position; relation is the separate lateral reference (e.g. a category pointing at which report it belongs to).
text: Opret, omd\u{f8}b, flyt eller \u{e6}ndr relationen for enhver entitet direkte. For\u{e6}lder er den reelle position i hierarkiet; relation er den separate, laterale reference (f.eks. en kategori, der angiver, hvilken rapport den h\u{f8}rer til).

concept: Customers with an overdue balance right now. Sending a reminder advances their level (up to 3, the firmest) \u{2014} the next one for the same customer is already pre-set to the following level.
text: Kunder med en aktuelt forfalden saldo. Afsendelse af en rykker for\u{f8}ger deres rykkerniveau (op til 3, det mest bestemte) \u{2014} den n\u{e6}ste rykker til samme kunde er allerede forudindstillet til det f\u{f8}lgende niveau.

concept: Every item at every location currently at or below its own reorder level \u{2014} the real trigger for "time to order," distinct from the floor min level, which only says something has already gone wrong.
text: Hver vare p\u{e5} hver lokation, der aktuelt er p\u{e5} eller under sit eget genbestillingsniveau \u{2014} det reelle udl\u{f8}sningspunkt for "tid til at bestille", adskilt fra det absolutte minimumsniveau, som blot siger, at noget allerede er g\u{e5}et galt.

concept: Every item at every location that carries real stock \u{2014} what you have, and where. Min, max, and reorder levels are editable directly here \u{2014} change a value and it saves as soon as you leave the field.
text: Hver vare p\u{e5} hver lokation, der har reel lagerbeholdning \u{2014} hvad du har, og hvor. Minimum-, maksimum- og genbestillingsniveauer kan redigeres direkte her \u{2014} \u{e6}ndr en v\u{e6}rdi, og den gemmes, s\u{e5} snart du forlader feltet.

concept: Fill in your details below. A staff member will check your card before your account is fully active.
text: Udfyld dine oplysninger nedenfor. En medarbejder vil tjekke dit kort, f\u{f8}r din konto er fuldt aktiv.

concept: Fulfills (all or item of) a Purchase Order. Toggle "service" off for a physical item to also track its stock quantity \u{2014} leave it on for anything with no quantity to track (labour, a service performed).
text: Opfylder (helt eller delvist) en indk\u{f8}bsordre. Sl\u{e5} "tjenesteydelse" fra for en fysisk vare for ogs\u{e5} at registrere dens lagerantal \u{2014} lad det v\u{e6}re til for alt uden en m\u{e6}ngde at registrere (arbejdskraft, en udf\u{f8}rt tjenesteydelse).

concept: Fulfills (all or item of) a Sales Order \u{2014} ships and invoices in one action. Toggle "service" off for a physical item to also recognize its cost of goods sold and reduce stock on hand.
text: Opfylder (helt eller delvist) en salgsordre \u{2014} afsender og fakturerer i \u{e9}n handling. Sl\u{e5} "tjenesteydelse" fra for en fysisk vare for ogs\u{e5} at bogf\u{f8}re dens vareforbrug og reducere lagerbeholdningen.

concept: Move stock between two locations in the same city \u{2014} a warehouse dispatching to its local retail outlets, for example. Not a sale: no GL entry, no revenue, no customer, just stock moving between places this business controls.
text: Flyt varer mellem to lokationer i samme by \u{2014} f.eks. et lager, der afsender til sine lokale butikker. Ikke et salg: ingen postering i hovedbogen, ingen indt\u{e6}gt, ingen kunde, blot varer der flyttes mellem steder, denne virksomhed selv kontrollerer.

concept: Purchase and Sales Orders are commitments only \u{2014} placing one never touches a real account. Fulfilling one (a Stock Receipt or Dispatch) is what actually posts to the ledger.
text: Indk\u{f8}bs- og salgsordrer er kun forpligtelser \u{2014} at oprette en ber\u{f8}rer aldrig en rigtig konto. Det er opfyldelsen (en lagermodtagelse eller -afsendelse), der reelt bogf\u{f8}rer i hovedbogen.

concept: Purpose-built entry screens for the most common transactions \u{2014} each posts through the same atomic journal mechanism as everything else.
text: Sk\u{e6}rmbilleder bygget specifikt til de mest almindelige transaktioner \u{2014} hvert af dem bogf\u{f8}rer gennem samme atomare journalmekanisme som alt andet.

concept: Retail outlets and warehouses \u{2014} each has a real street address and phone number (the exact same mechanism already used for customers and vendors), a city (locations in the same city can transfer stock between each other), and the real physical capacity of the space. Retail outlets track both shelving (bottles) and floor area (cartons), and, separately, real cold storage (sparkling wine, some beer) \u{2014} genuinely smaller, distinct real estate, not a subdivision of the same shelf space, with its own real total. A warehouse deals in full cartons only.
text: Butikker og lagre \u{2014} hver har en rigtig gadeadresse og telefonnummer (pr\u{e6}cis samme mekanisme, der allerede bruges til kunder og leverand\u{f8}rer), en by (lokationer i samme by kan overf\u{f8}re varer til hinanden), og den reelle fysiske kapacitet af rummet. Butikker registrerer b\u{e5}de hyldeplads (flasker) og gulvareal (kasser), og desuden reel k\u{f8}lelagring (mousserende vin, noget \u{f8}l) \u{2014} reelt et mindre, adskilt areal, ikke en underopdeling af samme hyldeplads, med sin egen reelle totale kapacitet. Et lager h\u{e5}ndterer udelukkende hele kasser.

concept: Every entity in the system, in hierarchy order \u{2014} the whole application (chart of accounts, business reports, languages, vocabulary, businesses/ledgers) is one tree, walked here directly from parent_id.

concept: The real billing event \u{2014} this is what creates AP and recognizes expense, distinct from a Dispatch Note/Goods Receipt which only moves stock. Credit Notes and Debit Memos use the same mechanism in reverse.
text: Den reelle faktureringsh\u{e6}ndelse \u{2014} det er dette, der skaber AP og bogf\u{f8}rer en omkostning, adskilt fra en f\u{f8}lgeseddel/modtagelse, der kun flytter varer. Kreditnotaer og debetnotaer bruger samme mekanisme omvendt.

concept: The real billing event \u{2014} this is what creates AR and recognizes revenue, distinct from a Dispatch Note/Goods Receipt which only moves stock. Credit Notes and Debit Memos use the same mechanism in reverse.

concept: Fulfills (all or item of) a Purchase Order. Toggle "service" off for a physical item to also track its stock quantity \u{2014} leave it on for anything with no quantity to track (labour, a service performed).
text: Erf\u{fc}llt (ganz oder teilweise) eine Bestellung. Schalten Sie \u{201e}Dienstleistung" f\u{fc}r einen physischen Artikel aus, damit zus\u{e4}tzlich dessen Lagermenge erfasst wird \u{2014} lassen Sie es eingeschaltet f\u{fc}r alles ohne zu erfassende Menge (Arbeitszeit, eine erbrachte Dienstleistung).

concept: Fulfills (all or item of) a Sales Order \u{2014} ships and invoices in one action. Toggle "service" off for a physical item to also recognize its cost of goods sold and reduce stock on hand.
text: Erf\u{fc}llt (ganz oder teilweise) einen Kundenauftrag \u{2014} versendet und stellt in einem Schritt in Rechnung. Schalten Sie \u{201e}Dienstleistung" f\u{fc}r einen physischen Artikel aus, damit zus\u{e4}tzlich dessen Wareneinsatz erfasst und der Lagerbestand verringert wird.

concept: Move stock between two locations in the same city \u{2014} a warehouse dispatching to its local retail outlets, for example. Not a sale: no GL entry, no revenue, no customer, just stock moving between places this business controls.
text: Bewegen Sie Ware zwischen zwei Standorten in derselben Stadt \u{2014} zum Beispiel ein Lager, das an seine \u{f6}rtlichen Verkaufsstellen ausliefert. Kein Verkauf: keine Hauptbuchbuchung, kein Umsatz, kein Kunde, es bewegt sich lediglich Ware zwischen Orten, die dieses Unternehmen selbst kontrolliert.

concept: Purchase and Sales Orders are commitments only \u{2014} placing one never touches a real account. Fulfilling one (a Stock Receipt or Dispatch) is what actually posts to the ledger.
text: Bestellungen und Kundenauftr\u{e4}ge sind nur Verpflichtungen \u{2014} das Anlegen ber\u{fc}hrt nie ein reales Konto. Erst die Erf\u{fc}llung (ein Wareneingang oder -ausgang) bucht tats\u{e4}chlich ins Hauptbuch.

concept: Purpose-built entry screens for the most common transactions \u{2014} each posts through the same atomic journal mechanism as everything else.
text: Eigens f\u{fc}r die h\u{e4}ufigsten Gesch\u{e4}ftsvorf\u{e4}lle gebaute Erfassungsmasken \u{2014} jede bucht \u{fc}ber denselben atomaren Journalmechanismus wie alles andere.

concept: Retail outlets and warehouses \u{2014} each has a real street address and phone number (the exact same mechanism already used for customers and vendors), a city (locations in the same city can transfer stock between each other), and the real physical capacity of the space. Retail outlets track both shelving (bottles) and floor area (cartons), and, separately, real cold storage (sparkling wine, some beer) \u{2014} genuinely smaller, distinct real estate, not a subdivision of the same shelf space, with its own real total. A warehouse deals in full cartons only.
text: Verkaufsstellen und Lager \u{2014} jede hat eine echte Stra\u{df}enadresse und Telefonnummer (genau derselbe Mechanismus, der bereits f\u{fc}r Kunden und Lieferanten verwendet wird), eine Stadt (Standorte in derselben Stadt k\u{f6}nnen untereinander Ware umlagern) und die tats\u{e4}chliche physische Kapazit\u{e4}t des Raums. Verkaufsstellen erfassen sowohl Regalfl\u{e4}che (Flaschen) als auch Bodenfl\u{e4}che (Kartons) und, getrennt davon, echte K\u{fc}hllagerung (Schaumwein, manches Bier) \u{2014} eine echt kleinere, eigenst\u{e4}ndige Fl\u{e4}che, keine Unterteilung derselben Regalfl\u{e4}che, mit eigener realer Gesamtmenge. Ein Lager handelt ausschlie\u{df}lich mit vollen Kartons.

concept: Every entity in the system, in hierarchy order \u{2014} the whole application (chart of accounts, business reports, languages, vocabulary, businesses/ledgers) is one tree, walked here directly from parent_id.
text: Jede Entit\u{e4}t im System, in hierarchischer Reihenfolge \u{2014} die gesamte Anwendung (Kontenrahmen, Business-Reports, Sprachen, Vokabular, Unternehmen/Hauptb\u{fc}cher) ist ein einziger Baum, hier direkt \u{fc}ber parent_id durchlaufen.

concept: The real billing event \u{2014} this is what creates AP and recognizes expense, distinct from a Dispatch Note/Goods Receipt which only moves stock. Credit Notes and Debit Memos use the same mechanism in reverse.
text: Das reale Fakturierungsereignis \u{2014} dies erzeugt AP und erfasst Aufwand, zu unterscheiden von einem Lieferschein/Wareneingang, der nur Ware bewegt. Gutschriften und Lastschriften nutzen denselben Mechanismus umgekehrt.

concept: The real billing event \u{2014} this is what creates AR and recognizes revenue, distinct from a Dispatch Note/Goods Receipt which only moves stock. Credit Notes and Debit Memos use the same mechanism in reverse.
text: Das reale Fakturierungsereignis \u{2014} dies erzeugt AR und erfasst Ertrag, zu unterscheiden von einem Lieferschein/Wareneingang, der nur Ware bewegt. Gutschriften und Lastschriften nutzen denselben Mechanismus umgekehrt.

concept: Every account with a posted balance, split into its debit or credit column. Any ledger in {NAME} should balance \u{2014} Actual, or any proposed budget.
text: Jedes Konto mit einem gebuchten Saldo, aufgeteilt in seine Soll- oder Haben-Spalte. Jedes Hauptbuch in {NAME} sollte ausgeglichen sein \u{2014} das tats\u{e4}chliche, oder jedes vorgeschlagene Budget.
Spese per interessi o oneri finanziari

concept: Welcome to Better Brighter Multi-Ledger \u{2014} please log in.
text: Benvenuto su Better Brighter Multi-Ledger \u{2014} accedi.

concept: A direct, multi-line entry into the ledger \u{2014} debits and credits across any accounts, balanced to zero. Fill in the header fields, add lines until the entry balances, then Save.
text: Una registrazione diretta e su pi\u{f9} righe nel registro \u{2014} dare e avere su qualsiasi conto, in pareggio a zero. Compila i campi in testata, aggiungi righe finch\u{e9} la registrazione non torna in pareggio, quindi salva.

concept: A payment received from a customer (cash, cheque, or EFT) \u{2014} debits Cash and Bank, credits their Accounts Receivable balance.
text: Un pagamento ricevuto da un cliente (contanti, assegno o bonifico) \u{2014} addebita cassa e banca, accredita il suo saldo verso clienti.

concept: A payment to a vendor \u{2014} debits their Accounts Payable balance, credits Cash and Bank.
text: Un pagamento a un fornitore \u{2014} addebita il suo saldo verso fornitori, accredita cassa e banca.

concept: A physical inventory count for one location \u{2014} the sheet is ordered the way you actually walk the floor (shelf side, then rack, then top to bottom), not alphabetically by item name. Completing it posts any real variance to the ledger and corrects quantity on hand to match what was actually counted.
text: Un inventario fisico per una sede \u{2014} il foglio \u{e8} ordinato secondo il percorso reale che si compie sul posto (lato scaffale, poi scaffalatura, poi dall'alto verso il basso), non in ordine alfabetico per nome articolo. Il suo completamento registra ogni scostamento reale nel registro e corregge la giacenza in modo che corrisponda a quanto effettivamente contato.

concept: A purchase from a vendor on credit \u{2014} debits an expense or asset account, credits their Accounts Payable balance.
text: Un acquisto a credito presso un fornitore \u{2014} addebita un conto di costo o di attivo, accredita il suo saldo verso fornitori.

concept: A sale to a customer on credit \u{2014} debits their Accounts Receivable balance, credits Sales Revenue.
text: Una vendita a credito a un cliente \u{2014} addebita il suo saldo verso clienti, accredita i ricavi delle vendite.

concept: Commits to buying from a vendor \u{2014} memo only, no real ledger effect until a Stock Receipt fulfills it (all or item).
text: Impegna all'acquisto presso un fornitore \u{2014} solo una nota, senza alcun effetto reale sul registro finch\u{e9} un ricevimento di merce non lo evade (in tutto o in parte).

concept: Create, rename, reparent, or change the relation of any entity directly. Parent is the real hierarchy position; relation is the separate lateral reference (e.g. a category pointing at which report it belongs to).
text: Crea, rinomina, riassegna il genitore o modifica la relazione di qualsiasi entit\u{e0} direttamente. Il genitore \u{e8} la posizione reale nella gerarchia; la relazione \u{e8} il riferimento laterale distinto (ad es. una categoria che indica a quale report appartiene).

concept: Customers with an overdue balance right now. Sending a reminder advances their level (up to 3, the firmest) \u{2014} the next one for the same customer is already pre-set to the following level.
text: Clienti con un saldo attualmente scaduto. L'invio di un sollecito fa avanzare il loro livello (fino a 3, il pi\u{f9} deciso) \u{2014} il sollecito successivo per lo stesso cliente \u{e8} gi\u{e0} preimpostato al livello seguente.

concept: Every item at every location currently at or below its own reorder level \u{2014} the real trigger for "time to order," distinct from the floor min level, which only says something has already gone wrong.
text: Ogni articolo, in ogni sede, che si trova attualmente al livello di riordino o al di sotto di esso \u{2014} il vero segnale che indica "\u{e8} ora di ordinare", distinto dal livello minimo assoluto, che indica solo che qualcosa \u{e8} gi\u{e0} andato storto.

concept: Every item at every location that carries real stock \u{2014} what you have, and where. Min, max, and reorder levels are editable directly here \u{2014} change a value and it saves as soon as you leave the field.
text: Ogni articolo, in ogni sede, che detiene giacenza reale \u{2014} cosa hai e dove. I livelli minimo, massimo e di riordino sono modificabili direttamente qui \u{2014} cambia un valore e viene salvato non appena esci dal campo.

text: Compila i tuoi dati qui sotto. Un membro del personale verificher\u{e0} la tua carta prima che il tuo account sia pienamente attivo.

text: Evade (in tutto o in parte) un ordine di acquisto. Disattiva "servizio" per un articolo fisico per tenere traccia anche della sua quantit\u{e0} a magazzino \u{2014} lascialo attivo per tutto ci\u{f2} che non ha una quantit\u{e0} da tracciare (manodopera, una prestazione eseguita).

text: Evade (in tutto o in parte) un ordine di vendita \u{2014} spedisce e fattura in un'unica operazione. Disattiva "servizio" per un articolo fisico per registrare anche il relativo costo del venduto e ridurre la giacenza.

concept: Move stock between two locations in the same city \u{2014} a warehouse dispatching to its local retail outlets, for example. Not a sale: no GL entry, no revenue, no customer, just stock moving between places this business controls.
text: Sposta la merce tra due sedi nella stessa citt\u{e0} \u{2014} ad esempio un magazzino che rifornisce i propri punti vendita locali. Non \u{e8} una vendita: nessuna registrazione contabile, nessun ricavo, nessun cliente, solo merce che si sposta tra luoghi controllati da questa stessa azienda.

text: Gli ordini di acquisto e di vendita sono solo impegni \u{2014} crearne uno non tocca mai un conto reale. \u{c8} il suo evasione (un ricevimento o un'uscita di merce) a registrare realmente nel registro.

concept: Purpose-built entry screens for the most common transactions \u{2014} each posts through the same atomic journal mechanism as everything else.
text: Schermate di inserimento create appositamente per le operazioni pi\u{f9} comuni \u{2014} ciascuna registra tramite lo stesso meccanismo atomico di registrazione di tutto il resto.

concept: Retail outlets and warehouses \u{2014} each has a real street address and phone number (the exact same mechanism already used for customers and vendors), a city (locations in the same city can transfer stock between each other), and the real physical capacity of the space. Retail outlets track both shelving (bottles) and floor area (cartons), and, separately, real cold storage (sparkling wine, some beer) \u{2014} genuinely smaller, distinct real estate, not a subdivision of the same shelf space, with its own real total. A warehouse deals in full cartons only.
text: Punti vendita e magazzini \u{2014} ciascuno ha un vero indirizzo stradale e un numero di telefono (esattamente lo stesso meccanismo gi\u{e0} usato per clienti e fornitori), una citt\u{e0} (le sedi nella stessa citt\u{e0} possono trasferirsi merce tra loro) e la capacit\u{e0} fisica reale dello spazio. I punti vendita tengono traccia sia dello spazio a scaffale (bottiglie) sia della superficie a terra (cartoni), e, separatamente, di un vero spazio refrigerato (vino spumante, alcune birre) \u{2014} uno spazio realmente pi\u{f9} piccolo e distinto, non una suddivisione dello stesso spazio a scaffale, con il proprio totale reale. Un magazzino tratta esclusivamente cartoni interi.
